chapter: Hightower: New Orleans parades and early players
title: Parades and social clubs in New Orleans today
summary: They talk about funeral and lodge parades today and the clubs, the Bulls and the Lions.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: Well, they still do, yes. They still do that. Every Sunday there'll be a parade in the summertime. Two weeks ago, before I came up, there were three parades that Sunday. Is that so? Yeah. And they still bury with the band? Yes. Not so many, but maybe one a week there'll be a few... There are lodges and things, good clubs.
They bury with a band. You see, I belong to the Tanninist Social Club, and I belong to the Bulls.

Oh, yes. The Bulls is uptown. They sold out under the Elks. They sold out under the Elks. It's on the Dan Neal and the... And the Lions is downtown yet? I'm not sure about the Lions. I don't remember. They were French.
I think they were down by the Economy Hall.
Yeah, down there on Dumaine or something.
Dumaine, somewhere it's down there, see.
